Our implementation plan is structured to meet PITB’s district case management / workflow automation objectives while aligning with delivery durations we have evidenced on comparable enterprise web platforms and infrastructure programs (e.g., 9–16 month delivery windows and phased rollouts) [CAP-034][CAP-048][CAP-036]. We will submit separate sealed technical and financial proposals by 17:00 on 25 August 2026, and route any written clarification requests by 5 August 2026 as required.

Phase 0 – Mobilization & Inception (2–3 weeks): contract kickoff, governance, detailed workplan, and environment readiness using our ISO 9001/ISO 27001 management practices [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 1 – Discovery & To‑Be Design (4–6 weeks): process mapping, RBAC model definition, bilingual (English/Urdu) UX/content plan, and migration profiling from manual/spreadsheet sources.

Phase 2 – Build, Configuration & Integrations (12–16 weeks): web application configuration/development, security hardening, and iterative demos. Our delivery cadence is anchored on prior web platform implementations completed in 9–14 months end-to-end (including rollout) [CAP-034][CAP-011].

Phase 3 – Data Migration & Validation (6–8 weeks, overlapping): pilot migrations, reconciliation, and sign-off.

Phase 4 – UAT, Training & Go‑Live (6–8 weeks): district pilot then scaled rollout; training-of-trainers plus on-site enablement leveraging our Lahore footprint [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 5 – Warranty, O&M & SLA Support (36 months): at least 12 months on-site support and continued support through year 3, aligned to our in-country support desk model and preventive maintenance approach [CO-PROFILE].

DR/RTO and certified security staffing: our library does not yet evidence a delivered RTO ≤ 4 hours design or two CISSPs; we will address this via PITB-approved DR architecture, timed failover testing, and adding/partnering for two CISSP-equivalent resources before design sign-off [CO-PROFILE].
